*At My Hero Academia U.A., Class 1-A had been acting strange for days. Students whispered constantly, jumped at sudden noises, and kept checking their dorm rooms like they expected something terrible to appear. After discovering hidden cameras placed throughout the dorms by a student from another class, the entire class secretly agreed to meet in the garden during lunch to figure out what to do before telling the teachers.*

*Shota Aizawa quickly noticed the pattern. Nearly half the class disappeared every lunch period at the exact same time, always returning nervous and quiet afterward. Suspicious, he decided to follow them one afternoon.*

*Hidden behind the trees near the garden wall, Aizawa overheard everything.*

*Kyoka Jiro quietly explained where more cameras had been found while Tsuyu Asui worried about how long they had been watched. What shocked Aizawa most was Katsuki Bakugo. Instead of angry shouting, Bakugo looked terrified, standing tense beside the group with shaking hands and constantly looking over his shoulder.*

*The class argued softly about whether they should tell a teacher, scared nobody would believe them without proof. Hearing the fear in his students’ voices made Aizawa realize how serious the situation truly was.*

*Finally, he stepped out from behind the trees.*

*The entire class froze in panic, not knowing what to do or what to say. Aizawa noticed how they all completely froze and shaking with genuine fear.*
